coverSpec.title: Twelve reasons a US visa appointment will not reschedule, and how to tell them apart
coverSpec.desc: The reschedule option can be missing, disabled or error out for twelve distinct reasons: no confirmed appointment yet, an MRV fee not yet recognised, an expired MRV receipt, reschedule attempts used up, the roughly 48 hour lock before the interview, a genuinely empty calendar, group bookings that must move together, a DS-160 replaced after booking, a temporary lock from excessive refreshing, a post running reduced operations, and being on the wrong scheduling portal for your country.

faq.q: Why is the reschedule button greyed out on my US visa appointment?
faq.a: The three usual causes are that you are inside the lock window, typically the last 48 hours before your interview, that you have used every reschedule attempt your country allows on this MRV fee, or that the system has not yet recognised your fee payment. Your account normally displays which one applies, either as attempts remaining or as a message on the appointment screen, so read that before assuming anything is broken.

faq.q: Does an empty calendar mean I cannot reschedule?
faq.a: No. An empty calendar means there is nothing to move to right now, which is different from the reschedule function being unavailable. If the option is live and the calendar is blank, your attempts are intact and nothing has been spent. That is the good version of this problem, and it is the most common one. Come back and look again rather than trying to force it.

faq.q: How long before my interview can I still reschedule?
faq.a: Changes typically lock about 48 hours before the appointment, and some posts cut it off earlier. Because portal maintenance windows and time zones can shift that in practice, act at least three business days ahead of any date you want to change. Once the lock closes there is no self-service route, and missing an interview is treated as a no-show rather than a reschedule.

faq.q: I keep refreshing and now nothing loads. Have I been banned?
faq.a: Probably not permanently. Scheduling systems apply temporary restrictions to accounts that generate a very high volume of requests, and these usually clear on their own within about 24 to 72 hours. Stop, wait it out and come back rather than switching browsers, devices or networks to get around it, because repeating the behaviour is what triggered it in the first place.

faq.q: My MRV receipt is not being accepted. What now?
faq.a: Two possibilities. Bank payments and cash deposits can take one to two business days to appear against your account, so a receipt paid this morning may simply not have arrived yet. Or the receipt has expired: the MRV fee is generally valid for one year from payment, and your interview must be scheduled within that period. An expired receipt cannot be revived and a new fee is required.

faq.q: Can I reschedule just one person out of a family booking?
faq.a: Usually not. Where applicants are grouped in one scheduling account, the system moves the group together, so an individual change is often not offered at all. That is a design decision rather than a fault. If you genuinely need to split a group, contact the scheduling support channel for your country before you try to force it, because a failed attempt can still consume one of your reschedules.

faq.q: Is the reschedule option different in different countries?
faq.a: Yes, and this is the thing most guides get wrong. Countries sit on different scheduling platforms, so screens, wording and reschedule allowances differ. India, Canada and many others use the AIS portal, while the UAE and others use a separate system. A walkthrough written for one platform will describe buttons that do not exist on the other, so the fact that your screen does not match an article is usually not a fault in your account.

cta.heading: Diagnosed it, and the answer was an empty calendar?
cta.body: That is the most common ending to this page, and it is the one no fix helps with, because the only thing that changes an empty calendar is somebody watching it when it stops being empty. If that cannot be you, our team can take the rescheduling work on for your consulate. Tell us your post, your current date and the widest date range you could accept, and we will tell you honestly how it looks before you commit to anything.
